question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched position as CCP General Secretary, state president, and Central Military Commission chairman underpins the 95% trader consensus against his removal before 2027. He has centralized authority through personnel appointments and ideological controls, with no visible elite factions or military challenges emerging ahead of the 21st Party Congress. Recent activities, including leadership of the Fourth Plenum and preparations for the 2026-2030 Five-Year Plan, signal continuity rather than transition. Structural barriers such as loyal security apparatus and surveillance mechanisms further reduce near-term risks. While sudden health events, elite fractures from economic pressures, or external shocks remain conceivable triggers for shifts, these lack supporting indicators in the current political environment.
